component.name: Patrone Unpack
component.summary: Open archives as folders, and install Flatpak apps

description.p: Patrone Unpack opens zip, tar, 7z and rar archives, and single compressed files, as folders: look inside, open a file, or use Extract all or Extract here.

It also opens Flatpak files (.flatpakref, .flatpak and .flatpakrepo) and says what each is, and installs Flatpak apps for your account with no password. Installed from its own package on Ubuntu, it installs .deb packages too, with an administrator's password.
Patrone Unpack as a Flatpak, for any Linux.
